response.description:
Customers previously could not
enable LocalDNS on clusters that used Node auto‑provisioning in AKS, limiting
their ability to use this feature in those environments. LocalDNS is now
generally available for AKS clusters with Node auto‑provisioning, providing DNS
resolution capabilities within the cluster.   Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Node auto-provisioning enabled clusters in AKS now support LocalDNS
